name: Postcard
summary: A postcard from where the poster is: friends sign the back with a line each and slam a stamp in the corner under a postmark with the place and date; flip it for the drawn 'Greetings from' front.
useWhen: wish you were all here, cartagena is unreal
miss yall so much from tokyo
having fun in south america eating tostadas
everyone sign a postcard for maya
send her something from all of us while shes away
dontUseWhen: a birthday or welcome card (use welcome-card)
asking what to do somewhere (use try-this-here)
a multi-stop trip with souvenirs (use souvenir-passport)

author.description: Who is away; the postcard is addressed to them

place.description: Where they are, printed big on the front and on the postmark

scene.description: Which picture to draw on the front

line.description: The post's own line, shown in quotes under the title

signed.description: Friends who already signed: their line in their own words and the stamp they picked
